title: AADP Relations Module v1.0 — Relation item
description: Component schema (not a top-level module document kind); one entry of a relation-set's `items` array (specification.md §5). This schema only enforces field shape — cardinality/container consistency (`one` must carry exactly `target`; `many` must carry exactly one of `targets`/`collection`; inline `targets` capped at 100) is a pure semantic check (`relations.semantic.cardinality`), deliberately not expressed here, so a structurally well-formed but cardinality-inconsistent document still reaches that check instead of failing generic schema validation.
